description: Defines the OverflowTextBlock control class for UI overflow handling with scrolling and accessibility features in a calculator app.

classes.name: OverflowTextBlock
classes.description: Custom control for displaying overflowing text with scroll buttons and accessibility support.

methods.name: OnTokensUpdatedPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when the TokensUpdated property changes, updating layout and accessibility view.

methods.name: OnScrollButtonsPlacementPropertyChanged
methods.description: Adjusts padding and margin based on scroll button placement.

methods.name: UpdateScrollButtons
methods.description: Updates visibility and focus of scroll buttons based on content scroll position.

methods.name: UnregisterEventHandlers
methods.description: Detaches event handlers from UI elements.

methods.name: OnViewChanged
methods.description: Updates scroll button visibility on view change.

methods.name: UpdateVisualState
methods.description: Updates visual state based on activity.
